name: memtether
description: Cross-client AI memory hub. SQLite + FTS5 + Bi-temporal + Source Attribution + layered recall (L0/L1/L2) + deterministic profiles. Local-first, no cloud. 23 client adapters.

tools.name: add_memories
tools.description: Write a memory to the shared hub

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Search the shared memory hub (hybrid: keyword + vector + BM25)

tools.name: correct_memory
tools.description: Correct a memory (supersede old, create new)

tools.name: pin_memory
tools.description: Pin/unpin a memory to always include in projection

tools.name: as_of_query
tools.description: Bi-temporal as-of query (what was true/known at a time)

tools.name: timeline
tools.description: Walk the supersession chain for a memory

tools.name: profile
tools.description: Deterministic subject representation (counts, time span, high-confidence facts, L0 digest). Zero LLM.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Write back Q-Value feedback for a memory
